title: Power Rankings: Spurs move up despite Duncan still down
heading: 2007-08 Power Rankings: Week 6
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Only Pop could greet a start like this with caution and/or indifference like this: ''We've had bad starts in the past, we've had good starts in the past and neither one is indicative of whether we won a championship.''
